title: allow the reviewer's go test ./... to bind unix sockets under its own TMPDIR, or name the packages it should skip in the brief

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-120630-a290, project ork, item S357:

allow the reviewer's go test ./... to bind unix sockets under its own TMPDIR, or name the packages it should skip in the brief

Evidence: the implementer's full suite failed with "setsockopt: operation not permitted" in ipc, tui, daemon, cmd/ork and cli, so nobody verified full-suite green for this slice
